translation_notes: Property path rdf:rest*/rdf:first (walk of an RDF list) makes the query a non-BGP: s{ }, not m{ }. ?surface is bound by initBindings and NOT projected (SELECT ?x ?y ?z), so it is interpolated in term position ({surface}). The call suffix (self.rdf) is used because the graph is an attribute, not a name that @graph could designate cleanly.

The original relies on the graph carrying the binding idf: (g.bind("idf", IDF) in Ontology.from_object); the translation obtains the same prefix with `from minergym_context import idf:` (the shim exports the Namespace IDF, a plain rdflib.Namespace as in minergym.ontology). rdf: is declared by @prefix (rdflib graphs predefine it).

Context shim minergym_context.py: TypeAlias (module-level annotation of the extraction), IDF = Namespace("https://energyplus.net/"), verbatim create_rdf_list / intern_object, and graph_from_object (body of Ontology.from_object, to build the graph the driver queries). original.py and translated.ldpy each gain one import line from the shim (TypeAlias is a typing import upstream).

Driver: self stub holding only .rdf; surfaces with 3, 2, 2 (one vertex lacking z), and 0 vertices, a non-surface node, an unknown name. Mutants: unbound ?surface (reads every surface) and rdf:rest*/rdf:first -> rdf:first (only the head of the list) both make the check FAIL.
